messages:
Emma: Heads-up — planning a lightweight schema change on user_sessions in tomorrow's 00:00-02:00 UTC change window. Adds nullable session_flags jsonb and a concurrent index on last_active. Looking for quick sign-off on migration approach + version pin for session-proxy.

Raj: Quick q — backfill needed for session_flags? If so, how are we chunking? concurrent index is fine but still worried about bloat/locks.

Emma: Backfill plan: no full rewrite. New rows get flags from app deploy. For historical rows we'll run a chunked updater (see snippet) with small txs. Index will be CONCURRENTLY so should avoid exclusive locks.

Sophie: FYI we hit a long VACUUM lag last time and that made concurrent index fail with "could not serialize" retriable errors. Recommend smaller chunk sizes and monitor replication lag.

Mike: Also we should pin session-proxy image to commit sha so rollout can be rolled back without schema drift. Example: session-proxy:sha256:8a2f9d... Set deploy manifest to that.

Emma: Agreed. I'll pin to sha256:8a2f9d3 and add a deployment note.

DeployBot: New release created by Emma — release/2026-03-25-schema-user-sessions. Pipelines: migration-job -> canary -> rollout. Status: pending approval. :rocket:

Emma: Migration SQL (preview):
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_flags JSONB;
COMMIT;
-- build index concurrently to avoid exclusive lock
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_sessions_last_active ON user_sessions (last_active DESC);
```
Chunked backfill (psql loop):
```bash
UPDATE user_sessions SET session_flags = '{}' WHERE session_flags IS NULL AND id BETWEEN $START AND $END;
```

Raj: Suggest chunk size = 2000 rows, pause 200ms between chunks, and stop if replication lag > 100s. Ops runbook updated?

Sophie: Add a post-migration check: count NULLs pre/post, sample reads on replicas, and ensure downstream consumer (session-aggregator) tolerates NULL.

Mike: Rollback plan: if index build fails or wide slowdown, revert by: 1) pause backfill, 2) roll session-proxy back to pinned sha, 3) remove index later if needed. No immediate column drops.

Emma: I'll author release notes and include explicit rollback steps + link to runbook. Also will add feature flag gating in session-proxy so new code only reads flags behind FF.

OpsBot: Reminder — set maintenance flag for write-heavy endpoints during index build window: /api/v1/sessions/create. Also add an alert: DB_CPU > 70% for 5m.

Raj: One more: can we schedule the index CREATE CONCURRENTLY after the backfill? Doing concurrently before backfill reduces bloat but backfill will rewrite many rows. I lean to backfill first then index. Thoughts?

Sophie: Backfill-first makes sense to avoid rebuilding index twice. But that means bigger replication lag during backfill. Tradeoffs documented in runbook.

Emma: Consensus: backfill chunked first, monitor lag, then create index CONCURRENTLY. I'll update the release checklist and assign preflight to @oncall. :thumbsup:

Mike: I'll be on-call for the window. Will watch replication and pg_stat_activity.

DeployBot: Approval requested from eng-release-approvers. Current approvers: none yet.

Emma: Pinged @Raj and @Mike for approvals. If I don't hear objections in 2h I'll mark approved and kick pipeline.

Raj: Approved from my side. :eyes:

Mike: Approved.

Emma: Thanks — scheduling migration job for 2026-03-25 00:15 UTC. I'll post a brief postmortem template entry after the window.

Sophie: Please capture the chunk metrics and vacuum timings.

Emma: Will do.
